Technical

Stats

Goblin_Ranger
Goblin Trackers are generic goblin characters found throughout Act One of Baldur's Gate 3.

Involvement

Hunters and scouts of goblinkind, they favour using ambushes and taking to the high ground to make up for their physical weaknesses in close quarters. Overall, they are relatively weak foes even to a low level party.

Despite lacking special abilities on their own, they are able to use all types of Arrows if they have any in their inventory.
